# Forward-chaining verifier for the boardgame question.
# Literals are strings; "~x" is the explicit negation of "x".
# A literal holds only if it is derived (no closed-world assumption).
# Conflicts between a rule and a contrary rule are resolved by the stated preferences.

def neg(lit):
    return lit[1:] if lit.startswith("~") else "~" + lit

# ---- game state as data ----
state = {
    "badger_name": "Luna",

    "gadwall_friends_kind": 6,

    "shark_name": "Tango",
    "vampire_age_years": 3,
}
DAYS_PER_YEAR = 365
SUBMITTED = "Proven"

# ---- derive base facts by computation from the state ----
facts = set()
total_friends = state["gadwall_friends_kind"] + state["gadwall_friends_unkind"]
if total_friends < 6:
    facts.add("gadwall_few_friends")
if any(c in state["france_flag_colors"] for c in state["gadwall_card_colors"]):

if state["badger_items"]:

if state["badger_name"][0] == state["shark_name"][0]:
    facts.add("badger_name_matches_shark")
if state["vampire_age_years"] * DAYS_PER_YEAR > 48:
    facts.add("vampire_over_48_days")
if state["mouse_refuses_help_to_stork"]:
    facts.add("mouse_refuses_help_to_stork")
if state["stork_location"] == "Canada":
    facts.add("stork_in_canada")
# No state fact says anything creates a castle for the fangtooth, so Rule9's
# antecedent "gadwall_creates_castle_fangtooth" is never derived.

# ---- rules: (id, antecedents, conclusion) ----
RULES = [
    {"id": "R1",  "ante": ["gadwall_few_friends"],                  "concl": "gadwall_builds_power_plant"},

    {"id": "R5",  "ante": ["~gadwall_hugs_pelikan", "~mannikin_unites_pelikan"],
                                                                     "concl": "pelikan_swears_lizard"},
    {"id": "R6",  "ante": ["vampire_over_48_days"],                 "concl": "vampire_takes_over_pelikan_emperor"},
    {"id": "R7",  "ante": ["badger_has_something_to_sit_on"],       "concl": "~badger_trades_mannikin"},
    {"id": "R8",  "ante": ["stork_surrenders_pelikan"],             "concl": "pelikan_hides_cards_from_fish"},
    {"id": "R9",  "ante": ["gadwall_creates_castle_fangtooth"],     "concl": "gadwall_hugs_pelikan"},
    {"id": "R10", "ante": ["badger_name_matches_shark"],            "concl": "~badger_trades_mannikin"},
    {"id": "R11", "ante": ["vampire_takes_over_pelikan_emperor"],   "concl": "~pelikan_hides_cards_from_fish"},
    {"id": "R12", "ante": ["gadwall_builds_power_plant"],           "concl": "~gadwall_hugs_pelikan"},
    {"id": "R13", "ante": ["mouse_refuses_help_to_stork"],          "concl": "stork_surrenders_pelikan"},
]
# (stronger, weaker): stronger rule defeats weaker rule when conclusions conflict.
PREFS = {("R13", "R2"), ("R8", "R11"), ("R9", "R12")}

# ---- fixpoint of defeasible forward chaining ----
S = set(facts)
converged = False
for _ in range(50):
    fired = [r for r in RULES if all(a in S for a in r["ante"])]

    for r in fired:
        defeated = any(

        if not defeated:
            accepted.add(r["concl"])
    new_S = facts | accepted
    if new_S == S:
        converged = True
        break
    S = new_S

    elif verdict == "Unknown":
        print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
    else:
        print("CHECK FAIL")
